## Review

The implementation remains functionally compliant:

- Fixed 16,384-row chunks are independent of worker count.
- The measured 5M-row threshold and scoped worker budget are present.
- Arithmetic, racing-clock, and reduction tests compare bitwise results across 1, 2, and 4 workers.
- Canonical `f64` reduction and conflict resolution remain sequential.
- Evidence records five before/default/single-worker runs, core counts, contention, and identical outputs/manifests.
- Required Rust gates passed on this unchanged HEAD during the preceding review; Markdown links and `git diff --check` pass currently.

However, acceptance criterion 2 and the allowed-file restriction remain violated. HEAD is still `529f1a2`, directly parented by `b8c3cb1`, with no subsequent separation commit or PRD-only working diff. Its implementation range changes eight `crates/sembla-runtime/examples/*_spike.rs` files:

```sh
git diff --name-only b8c3cb1..529f1a2 -- crates/sembla-runtime/examples
```

This is one unresolved scope-isolation issue, not eight separate defects.

adviceText:
## Assessment

The blocker is confirmed and remains the only issue. It is one history/scope policy failure covering all eight example files, not eight code defects.

Current evidence:

- HEAD is still `529f1a2`, parent `b8c3cb1`.
- No later separation commit exists.
- The non-managed worktree is clean.
- The prepared patch reverse-checks successfully.
- Piprd has already advanced to advisory attempt 3 without any repository revision.

The functional evaluator implementation must not be changed.

## Root cause

The run is retrying an implementation agent for work that requires an operator-created prerequisite commit. Because implementation agents cannot commit, another ordinary revision attempt will necessarily reproduce the same review failure.

## Required intervention before attempt 3

Suspend or terminate the current retry loop. The operator/piprd harness must run:

```sh
git apply --check --reverse /tmp/sembla-evaluator-prd0001-allowed.patch
git apply --reverse --index /tmp/sembla-evaluator-prd0001-allowed.patch

git diff --cached --name-only
git commit -m "Establish pre-PRD evaluator quality-gate baseline"

git apply /tmp/sembla-evaluator-prd0001-allowed.patch
```

Patch identity:

```text
/tmp/sembla-evaluator-prd0001-allowed.patch
ebc1f10e53d356034f4ee05c1c76df47f334c1c97b3edabeba18bc0ad70725cb
```

Do not stage managed `.piprd/**`.

## Class-level conformance checks

After the operator commit and patch reapplication:

```sh
# Candidate PRD diff: only allowed paths.
git diff --name-only HEAD

# Entire protected example class: no candidate changes.
test -z "$(git diff --name-only HEAD -- crates/sembla-runtime/examples)"

# Reapplied implementation remains byte-identical to the validated version.
git diff --quiet 529f1a2 -- \
  crates/sembla-runtime/src/eval.rs \
  crates/sembla-runtime/src/executor.rs \
  crates/sembla-runtime/tests \
  docs/evidence/evaluator-parallel-element-wise-20260727 \
  docs/prds-evaluator-throughput/README.md
```

Then run:

```sh
git diff --check
cargo test --locked
scripts/check-rust.sh
python3 scripts/check-markdown-links.py
```

## Risks to avoid

- Do not launch attempt 3 before the prerequisite commit exists.
- Do not reset or force-push published history.
- Do not revert the spike formatting cleanup.
- Do not modify evaluator behavior, threshold, tests, or evidence.
- Do not rerun performance measurements when the reapplication is byte-identical.
- Do not commit the reapplied PRD diff; piprd should commit it only after approval.
